"Treehouse of Horror XXI" is the fourth episode of the twenty-second season of the American animated television series The Simpsons. The first segment references Jumanji, the second is a loose parody of Dead Calm and the third satirizes the Twilight novel and film series.

Reproduction explains more of Treehouse of Horror XXI than any philosophy dares to admit. The idea of Bart and Milhouse playing with a Ouija board ripoff was promising, so to see it descend into gags about Marge getting sucked into Clue was disappointing. Alf Clausen's score for the episode received a nomination for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Music Composition for a Series at the 63rd Primetime Emmy Awards.
